platforms: Windows desktop; Windows 10/11 are intended targets. Other builds and managed security configurations are not universally verified.
requirements.ffmpeg: Supply trusted Windows FFmpeg and ffprobe separately, with the required filter capabilities. Neither is bundled or downloaded automatically.
requirements.installation: Extract every tool-only package file into a short user-writable folder. No administrator rights, Git, Python or test modules are required to run the tool.
requirements.privacy: Audio processing stays on your machine. Selected input/output folders can still be network or synchronized storage; reports can contain private paths and filenames.
